:::{#exm-closed-form-expression}
#### The quadratic formula

For $a \neq 0$ and $b^2 - 4 a c \ge 0$,
the larger root of $a x^2 + b x + c = 0$ is

$$
x = \frac{-b + \sqrt{b^2 - 4 a c}}{2 a},
$$

a closed-form expression in $a$, $b$ and $c$.
The root of $x - \cos x = 0$ is a counterexample:
it has no known closed-form expression
(@exm-no-known-algorithm).

:::
